trends.title: The Fed raised rates in September
trends.text: The Fed lifted its policy rate to 3.75%–4%, and officials' median outlook is about 4.1% at the end of 2026 and 2027. Savings rates usually move with it.

trends.title: Most savings still pay almost nothing
trends.text: The national average savings rate is 0.37% (money market 0.63%), so which account our cash sits in matters a lot.

trends.title: Higher retirement limits for 2026
trends.text: IRA limit rose to $7,500 (from $7,000) and 401(k)/403(b) to $24,500 (from $23,500).

trends.title: HSA limits up for 2026
trends.text: $4,400 for self-only and $8,750 for family coverage, if the health plan qualifies.
